raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

With an MXFP8 KV cache, HiCache L3 does not work at all: `MHATokenToKVPoolMXFP8Host` raises `NotImplementedError` for every storage page, because a page's UE8M0 scales live in their own host buffers, outside `kv_buffer`.

## Modifications

Each page is stored as two multi-buffer objects under the existing keys, so the key schema and every non-MXFP8 pool are unchanged:

| object | buffers (one page, all layers) |
|---|---|
| `{hash}_{rank}_k` | K payload, then K scales |
| `{hash}_{rank}_v` | V payload, then V scales |

`get_page_buffer_meta` returns those pointer/size pairs and `get_hybrid_pool_buffer` exposes both scale buffers for registration. Mooncake already stores nested buffer lists (`batch_put_from_multi_buffers`); flat storage pages stay unsupported.

## Accuracy Tests

| test | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| `test_storage_objects_round_trip_payload_and_scales` (new): pages stored through these pointers and loaded into another pool restore payload and scales; each object is exactly payload + scales | `NotImplementedError` | passes |

`test_mxfp8_mha_pool_host_unit.py`: 5 passed. End to end (PD with decode KV offload and MXFP8 KV, on a fork carrying this change): the prefill restores the KV the decode wrote; every turn's logprobs match a no-cache reference (max drift 4.4e-16).

Not run here: `test_hicache_storage_mooncake_backend.py` with an MXFP8 KV cache.

Related: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/46934, https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/46935, https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/46936, https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/46940.

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).

@@ -255,8 +255,9 @@ def destroy(self):
 
     def _storage_pages_unsupported(self) -> NotImplementedError:
         return NotImplementedError(
-            "MXFP8 KV host pool does not expose flat storage (L3) pages yet: "
-            "a page's UE8M0 scales live outside kv_buffer."
+            "MXFP8 KV host pool does not expose flat storage (L3) pages: a "
+            "page's UE8M0 scales live outside kv_buffer, so it is stored as a "
+            "multi-buffer object (get_page_buffer_meta)."
         )
 
     def get_data_page(self, index, flat: bool = True) -> torch.Tensor:
@@ -268,8 +269,27 @@ def get_dummy_flat_data_page(self) -> torch.Tensor:
     def set_from_flat_data_page(self, index: int, data_page: torch.Tensor) -> None:
         raise self._storage_pages_unsupported()
 
+    def get_hybrid_pool_buffer(self):
+        return [self.kv_buffer, self.k_scale_host, self.v_scale_host]
+
     def get_page_buffer_meta(self, indices):
-        raise self._storage_pages_unsupported()
+        """A page's K and V storage objects, each its payload followed by the
+        page's scales over all layers: one multi-buffer object under the
+        payload's key."""
+        payload_ptrs, payload_sizes = super().get_page_buffer_meta(indices)
+        pages = self._page_ids(indices).tolist()
+        assert len(payload_ptrs) == 2 * len(pages)
+        k_scale_bytes = self.layer_num * self.k_sf_page_bytes
+        v_scale_bytes = self.layer_num * self.v_sf_page_bytes
+        k_scale_ptr = self.k_scale_host.data_ptr()
+        v_scale_ptr = self.v_scale_host.data_ptr()
+        ptrs, sizes = [], []
+        for i, page in enumerate(pages):
+            ptrs.append([payload_ptrs[2 * i], k_scale_ptr + page * k_scale_bytes])
+            ptrs.append([payload_ptrs[2 * i + 1], v_scale_ptr + page * v_scale_bytes])
+            sizes.append([payload_sizes[2 * i], k_scale_bytes])
+            sizes.append([payload_sizes[2 * i + 1], v_scale_bytes])
+        return ptrs, sizes
 
     def get_split_heads_page_buffer_meta(
         self, indices: torch.Tensor, split_factor: int

@@ -1,6 +1,7 @@
 """Unit tests for the MXFP8 MHA host pool: UE8M0 scales must round-trip
 through L2 alongside the fp8 payload."""
 
+import ctypes
 import unittest
 from unittest import mock
 
@@ -199,13 +200,89 @@ def test_scales_round_trip_device_host_device(self):
             self.assertTrue(torch.equal(v_rows[layer][2:4], expected_v[layer]))
             self.assertTrue(torch.all(k_rows[layer][:2] == 0))
 
-    def test_storage_pages_are_rejected(self):
+    def test_flat_storage_pages_are_rejected(self):
         host = MHATokenToKVPoolMXFP8Host.__new__(MHATokenToKVPoolMXFP8Host)
         with self.assertRaises(NotImplementedError):
             host.get_dummy_flat_data_page()
         with self.assertRaises(NotImplementedError):
             host.get_data_page(0)
 
+    def test_storage_objects_round_trip_payload_and_scales(self):
+        """A page's K and V objects hold its payload then its scales: storing
+        them by pointer and loading them into another pool restores both."""
+
+        def make(seed):
+            host = _make_host([], [])
+            host.size = host.page_num * PAGE_SIZE
+            host.head_num, host.head_dim = HEAD_NUM, HEAD_DIM
+            host.dtype = torch.uint8
+            generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)
+            host.kv_buffer = torch.randint(
+                0,
+                256,
+                (2 * host.size * LAYER_NUM * HEAD_NUM * HEAD_DIM,),
+                dtype=torch.uint8,
+                generator=generator,
+            )
+            for scales in (host.k_scale_host, host.v_scale_host):
+                scales.copy_(
+                    torch.randint(
+                        0, 256, scales.shape, dtype=torch.uint8, generator=generator
+                    )
+                )
+            return host
+
+        def read(ptrs, sizes):
+            return b"".join(ctypes.string_at(p, s) for p, s in zip(ptrs, sizes))
+
+        def to_indices(pages):
+            return torch.cat(
+                [torch.arange(p * PAGE_SIZE, (p + 1) * PAGE_SIZE) for p in pages]
+            )
+
+        src, dst = make(0), make(1)
+        src_pages, dst_pages = [2, 0], [1, 3]
+        src_ptrs, src_sizes = src.get_page_buffer_meta(to_indices(src_pages))
+        objects = [read(p, s) for p, s in zip(src_ptrs, src_sizes)]
+        self.assertEqual(len(objects), 2 * len(src_pages))
+
+        payload_bytes = LAYER_NUM * PAGE_SIZE * HEAD_NUM * HEAD_DIM
+        v_offset = src.size * LAYER_NUM * HEAD_NUM * HEAD_DIM
+        for i, page in enumerate(src_pages):
+            k_start = page * payload_bytes
+            v_start = v_offset + k_start
+            self.assertEqual(
+                objects[2 * i],
+                bytes(src.kv_buffer[k_start : k_start + payload_bytes])
+                + bytes(src.k_scale_host[page].flatten()),
+            )
+            self.assertEqual(
+                objects[2 * i + 1],
+                bytes(src.kv_buffer[v_start : v_start + payload_bytes])
+                + bytes(src.v_scale_host[page].flatten()),
+            )
+
+        dst_ptrs, dst_sizes = dst.get_page_buffer_meta(to_indices(dst_pages))
+        for obj, ptrs, sizes in zip(objects, dst_ptrs, dst_sizes):
+            offset = 0
+            for ptr, size in zip(ptrs, sizes):
+                ctypes.memmove(ptr, obj[offset : offset + size], size)
+                offset += size
+        for src_page, dst_page in zip(src_pages, dst_pages):
+            self.assertTrue(
+                torch.equal(dst.k_scale_host[dst_page], src.k_scale_host[src_page])
+            )
+            self.assertTrue(
+                torch.equal(dst.v_scale_host[dst_page], src.v_scale_host[src_page])
+            )
+        self.assertEqual(
+            [
+                read(p, s)
+                for p, s in zip(*dst.get_page_buffer_meta(to_indices(dst_pages)))
+            ],
+            objects,
+        )
+
 
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
